summary: Alaunos Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement dated September 18, 2026, for a registered direct offering of 380,469 common shares at $1.46 per share and 386,654 pre-funded warrants at $1.459 each. Closing occurred September 21, 2026, with net proceeds of approximately $915,400.50 after placement agent fees and expenses. The pre-funded warrants have a $0.001 exercise price, no expiration, and a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker, offered to purchasers whose participation would otherwise exceed that threshold. Proceeds are designated for general corporate purposes and working capital. This is an ordinary shelf takedown rather than a special situation. Watch for dilution, warrant exercises, and thin Nasdaq capitalization.
